trip_id.description: Non-blank identifier. A value made only of spaces is rejected. Any other character, including surrounding spaces, is preserved.
trip_id.title: Trip Id

pickup_at.description: Timezone-aware pickup instant, stored in UTC.
pickup_at.title: Pickup At

dropoff_at.description: Timezone-aware dropoff instant, stored in UTC. An earlier instant is rejected.
dropoff_at.title: Dropoff At

trip_distance.description: Kilometers as an integer, Decimal, or canonical decimal string. The supplied fractional scale must be 3 or less. A finer literal is rejected and is not rounded.
trip_distance.title: Trip Distance
